  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Location: Remote — Europe or US East Coast (Virginia, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Florida only)

🎯 Your main goal will be to build n8n's global revenue enablement engine — installing one enterprise selling methodology across every region, compressing ramp for every revenue team worldwide, and turning our community-led momentum into repeatable 7–8 figure enterprise revenue.

You'll report directly to our senior commercial leadership, inherit a small enablement team with basic onboarding in place, and have the mandate (and explicit VP trajectory) to build the function from the ground up: for a remote-first company selling across EMEA, the US, and beyond.

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

METHODOLOGY & ENTERPRISE SELLING EXCELLENCE

  • Own the global install of one enterprise methodology (MEDDICC / value-selling framework): selection, rollout, certification, and continuous reinforcement across every rep and manager, in every region.

  • Build the PLG-to-enterprise playbook: teach sellers to convert community and self-serve signals into qualified 7-figure pipeline.

  • Partner with PMM and Product to arm the field with AI-led narratives, competitive plays, and launch enablement.

RAMP, ONBOARDING & MANAGER DEVELOPMENT

  • Build one global onboarding engine, pre-boarding through certification to first-deal support, and compress time-to-quota for hiring waves in every region.

  • Develop frontline sales managers: coaching frameworks, deal inspection, and forecast rigor that make the methodology stick.

  • Define enablement's scorecard in revenue terms: ramp time, win rate, forecast accuracy, not course completions.

BUILDING THE GLOBAL FUNCTION

  • Lead and grow the enablement team (starting with 1–2 ICs) across sales, SDR, CS, and partner enablement.

  • Stand up the enablement infrastructure: tooling, content systems, certification tracking, and measurement with RevOps.

  • Operate as a trusted peer to regional sales leaders across EMEA, the US, and future markets: in deal rooms, QBRs, and forecast reviews.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🚀 Hypergrowth pedigree: You built enablement at a developer-tool, open-source, or technical B2B SaaS company as it scaled enterprise.

  • 📈 €xm→€1bn scaling: You grew the function through a major GTM headcount wave and constant evolution of sales maturity. You've solved ramp at volume, not maintained steady-state.

  • 🧠 Methodology implementation owner: You've run a company-wide MEDDICC / Command of the Message-style install end-to-end, with certification and reinforcement that stuck.

  • ⏱️ Ramp engineer: You've built onboarding programs with measurable time-to-productivity compression.

  • 📊 Revenue-outcome mindset: You measure enablement in deal size, win rate, ramp time, and forecast accuracy.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎖️ Methodology-firm pedigree: Force Management, or similar as a consultant or a certified in-house champion.

  • 💼 Carried a bag: You sold enterprise deals yourself, so reps and leaders trust you in deal conversations.

  • 🌱 PLG-to-enterprise: You've enabled teams converting community/self-serve momentum into enterprise revenue.

  • 🤖 AI narrative: You've positioned AI/ML-driven products in enterprise settings and think of an AI first solution to solving problems.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into an LMS. You'll build the global enablement function at the exact moment we scale from community-led momentum into 7–8 figure enterprise deals - the moment enablement leaders at MongoDB or HashiCorp will tell you was the best of their career. You'll install the methodology worldwide, set one ramp standard across regions, develop managers on every continent we sell in, and grow the team, with a direct line to senior commercial leadership and an explicit path to VP. You'll join a fast-growing, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning.

About the role

n8n is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own and grow a defined enterprise territory across Northern Europe (UK&I, Nordics & Benelux) building pipeline, landing net-new logos, and expanding strategic accounts.

You’ll run a full-cycle, consultative enterprise motion (FTE 2,500+): uncovering technical and business needs, aligning multiple stakeholders, guiding evaluations, and closing high-impact six/seven-figure deals.

This role is ideal for someone who can sell to technical buyers (developers are our ICP), thrives in fast-growing environments, and uses a structured methodology (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC) to drive predictable outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

🎯 Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets across a defined Northern Europe enterprise territory

🧭 Build pipeline proactively (≥50%+ sourced by you) through outbound prospecting and smart territory/account planning

🔎 Run deep discovery and qualification using MEDDIC/MEDDPICC—uncovering pain, impact, decision process, decision criteria, and confirming real evidence before you forecast

🧱 Manage the full sales cycle end-to-end: discovery, demos, technical validation/evaluation, proposals, procurement, and negotiations

🧠 Translate technical value into business outcomes—aligning n8n’s automation + AI capabilities to measurable efficiency, risk reduction, and speed-to-delivery

🤝 Orchestrate multi-threaded deals across stakeholders (champions, technical evaluators, security, procurement, and economic buyers) to keep momentum and reduce stall risk

📝 Create and drive mutual action plans with customers—clear next steps, milestones, and shared accountability from first meeting to signature

📈 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene, forecast accuracy, and account notes in CRM (Salesforce) communicating clearly and early about risks and next steps

🔗 Partner tightly with Solutions Engineering, SDRs, Marketing, RevOps, and Customer Success to accelerate deals and ensure strong handoffs for expansion

🌍 Represent n8n at events and in-market—building credibility with technical communities and enterprise leaders across Northern Europe (with customer travel as needed)

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🏆 Enterprise SaaS sales track record: 5+ years in quota-carrying roles with consistent overachievement in enterprise segments

🌍 Northern Europe market expertise: Existing network and proven success selling into Northern Europe enterprises (plus relevant languages)

🧩 Complex deal leadership: Proven ability to close multi-stakeholder deals with longer cycles, procurement/legal steps, and high scrutiny

🔎 Methodology-driven execution (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC): You use structured qualification to build high-confidence pipeline and accurate forecasts

🗣️ Executive + technical buyer fluency: You can engage C-level stakeholders and also win credibility with technical audiences (DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops etc.)

🧠 Consultative selling: You lead with customer outcomes, ask sharp questions, and tailor your narrative to the customer’s reality—not a generic pitch

📊 Operational discipline: Strong CRM hygiene, forecast rigor, and a habit of using evidence to drive next steps and internal alignment

🤝 Collaboration mindset: You work smoothly with SE/CS/Marketing/RevOps and elevate the whole deal team, not just your own activity

Nice-to-haves

🧑‍💻 Open-source / community experience: You’ve sold in or alongside open-source ecosystems and understand bottoms-up adoption and PLG signals

🧪 Selling technical workflow/automation products: Experience with integration, API-first platforms, DevOps/SecOps/IT Ops, or adjacent categories

🚀 Early-stage / scale-up experience: You’ve helped build pipeline and playbooks in a fast-growing environment where process is evolving

Must-haves

  • 🔎 Production troubleshooting: You have diagnosed performance, reliability, and scalability challenges in production environments.

  • 💬 Clear technical communication: You can translate complex technical topics into actionable recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.

  • 🤝 Stakeholder management: You’re confident building trust with senior technical stakeholders and aligning internal teams around customer outcomes.

  • 🔁 Cross-functional collaboration: You have worked closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to solve customer challenges.

  • 🛠️ Strong DevOps and infrastructure experience, including hands-on exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, self-hosted deployments, cloud environments, and the operational considerations needed to run scalable, reliable production systems.

     

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔧 At least 6 months experience with n8n or similar workflow automation / iPaaS platforms such as Zapier, Make, Node-RED or similar.

  • 🤖 Familiarity with AI / LLM integrations, agentic workflows, or automation use cases involving AI-enabled business processes.

  • 🏢 Experience supporting both self-hosted and SaaS enterprise customers, especially in complex or highly regulated environments.

  • 🧑‍💻 Background working with open-source, developer-first, or technical platform products.

  • 📈 Previous exposure to scaling customer success or TAM motions in a high-growth SaaS or infrastructure company.

  • 🤝 Proactive and consultative in approach, with the ability to understand the business impact of technical issues, anticipate upcoming challenges, and stay organised across multiple customer priorities.

At n8n, you’ll play a key role in shaping how our most strategic customers scale their automation infrastructure with confidence. You’ll be the technical owner for long-term top tier partnerships, working closely with customers and internal teams to improve platform health, reduce operational risk, and turn real-world customer insights into better product outcomes.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at an exciting stage of growth, with the autonomy to build trusted relationships, influence how we deliver top tier support, and help define what exceptional technical success looks like for enterprise customers.

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

You’ll own the development of high-impact, long-term relationships with regional partners, helping them build successful service offerings around n8n and supporting our growth across the West Coast.

Here’s how you’ll make that happen:

🔍 Acquire and qualify high-potential partners

  • Build a strong understanding of the regional partner landscape and prioritize firms aligned with our go-to-market strategy.

  • Assess partner-market fit, technical capabilities, customer reach, and commercial potential.

  • Recruit partners motivated to build and scale dedicated automation and AI service offerings around n8n.

  • Develop relationships with senior stakeholders across partner organizations, from founders and practice leads to sales and delivery teams.

🧠 Enable, support, and scale partnerships

  • Design and deliver onboarding, enablement, and certification programs that help partners become commercially and technically successful.

  • Support partners in building internal n8n expertise, service packages, and repeatable implementation capabilities.

  • Create reusable resources, including playbooks, toolkits, templates, and best practices, to scale partner operations.

  • Drive partner education across technical, sales, and go-to-market tracks.

  • Help partners move from initial onboarding to active pipeline generation and customer delivery.

📈 Drive pipeline and co-selling success

  • Build, track, and grow partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline across the region.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to identify and activate opportunities.

  • Develop joint account plans and co-selling motions for strategic customers and prospects.

  • Co-own joint business plans with priority partners and ensure they deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Maintain clear visibility into partner performance, pipeline progression, and revenue contribution.

📣 Activate regional go-to-market initiatives

  • Plan and execute joint campaigns, webinars, events, and regional initiatives with partners.

  • Build strong relationships with local sales and field teams to ensure partners are embedded within regional go-to-market activity.

  • Represent n8n at relevant partner, industry, and technology events across the region.

  • Keep the partner ecosystem engaged through regular communication, updates, and community initiatives.

🌀 Champion partner feedback and continuous improvement

  • Act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape future programs, incentives, and product priorities.

  • Identify regional challenges and opportunities, and translate them into scalable improvements.

  • Use partner and performance data to improve the partner experience and increase operational efficiency.

  • Contribute to the evolution of n8n’s global partner program based on regional learnings.

  • Help define what excellent SI partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🚀 SaaS partnership experience: You have 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, alliances, or sales within fast-scaling SaaS or technology companies, including at least 3 years working directly with services partners as a quota-carrying individual contributor.

  • 🤝 Partner recruitment and enablement: You have recruited, onboarded, and scaled high-performing consulting, agency, or systems integration partners.

  • 📈 Commercial ownership: You have owned partner-sourced pipeline or revenue targets and know how to move partnerships from relationship-building to measurable commercial results.

  • ⚡ High-growth mindset: You have thrived in fast-paced technology environments and know how to prioritize, execute, and make decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • 📣 Strong communicator and collaborator: You build trust quickly and influence senior internal and external stakeholders with clarity, credibility, and confidence.

  • 💻 Technical depth: You are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, automation workflows, and the broader AI and automation landscape.

  • 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You enjoy creating programs and processes from scratch rather than maintaining static playbooks. You are hands-on, data-driven, and focused on outcomes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💼 Larger deal experience: You have supported partner-involved deals in the €100K to €500K range.

  • 🎯 GTM and co-sell experience: You understand regional go-to-market strategy, partner sales enablement, account mapping, and field collaboration.

  • 🔧 Industry knowledge: You have experience with iPaaS, workflow automation, AI, developer tools, or another technical SaaS platform.

  • 🏢 SI and enterprise experience: You have worked with systems integrators supporting complex software implementations for mid-market and enterprise customers.

  • 🌐 Regional network: You already have relationships with influential consulting firms, boutique SIs, digital agencies, or technology partners across the region.

🧠 Enable, support, and scale partnerships

 - Help partners move from initial onboarding to active pipeline generation and customer delivery.

 - Collaborate closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to identify and activate opportunities.

 - Plan and execute joint campaigns, webinars, events, and regional initiatives with partners.

 - Build strong relationships with local sales and field teams to ensure partners are embedded within regional go-to-market activity.

 - Represent n8n at relevant partner, industry, and technology events across the region.

 - Keep the partner ecosystem engaged through regular communication, updates, and community initiatives.

 - Act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape future programs, incentives, and product priorities.

 - Identify regional challenges and opportunities, and translate them into scalable improvements.

 - Use partner and performance data to improve the partner experience and increase operational efficiency.

 - Contribute to the evolution of n8n’s global partner program based on regional learnings.

 - Help define what excellent SI partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale.

 - 📣 Strong communicator and collaborator: You build trust quickly and influence senior internal and external stakeholders with clarity, credibility, and confidence.

 - 🌐 Regional network: You already have relationships with influential consulting firms, boutique SIs, digital agencies, or technology partners across the region.

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:

OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

  • Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

  • Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

  • Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.

MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

  • Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

  • Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

  • Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.

BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

  • Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

  • Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

  • Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.

TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

  • Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

  • Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

  • Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

  • 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

  • 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

  • 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

  • 🧭 Judgment on unattributable spend: You have built and defended investment cases for brand, community, content, or similar spend that will never attribute cleanly to a closed deal.

  • 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔄 PLG + SLG fluency: You have deep experience across both product-led and sales-led demand motions rather than primarily one.

  • 🧑‍💻 Developer-focused environment: You have worked at a community-led, open-source, or developer-focused product company.

  • 🧪 Incrementality & experimentation: You have exposure to incrementality testing, holdout design, or marketing mix modeling.

  • 🛠️ Marketing & RevOps tooling: You have experience consuming data from tools such as HubSpot or Marketo, GA4, attribution platforms, and Salesforce.

  • 📋 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity, or multi-stakeholder environments.

  • 🧑‍🔬 Data self-sufficiency: You are comfortable using SQL and building your own views in tools such as Looker, Metabase, or Hex rather than waiting on a Data team.

  • ⚙️ Relevant SaaS domain experience: You have worked in workflow automation, developer tools, or infrastructure SaaS.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll own the financial view of one of the most important joins in our growth engine: where community, product-led adoption, and enterprise demand generation meet. You’ll work closely with Marketing leadership and counterpart FP&A Managers covering the PLG and SLG bottom of funnel, giving you visibility across the full commercial plan and real influence over how we allocate one of our largest discretionary investments.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where finance is expected to help shape decisions, not simply report on them. As n8n expands the opportunity around AI agent orchestration and helps businesses unlock measurable ROI through automation, you’ll help build the planning discipline, investment frameworks, and automation-first finance practices that support our next stage of growth.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

We've moved to usage-based pricing, migrated to Salesforce, and built a serious data foundation. What we don't have yet is someone whose entire job is making sense of the sales side of it.

Own pipeline analytics, support forecasting

  • Build the models and views that tell us where pipeline actually stands - coverage, stage conversion, velocity, slippage.

  • Support RevOps on forecasting: supply the analysis and accuracy tracking behind it, and be the person leadership trusts to explain the number when it's uncomfortable.

  • Run win/loss analysis that goes past "price" and "timing" to something we can act on.

Connect product-led growth to sales

  • We have thousands of self-serve users and a sales team that can only talk to a fraction of them. Your job is to work out which fraction.

  • Build account and lead scoring on product usage and firmographic signal, with RevOps and the product/customer analysts.

  • Sharpen PQL and MQL definitions until reps trust what lands in their queue.

Shape how we plan

  • Model territories, quota and capacity for annual planning - and make the trade-offs visible.

  • Segment the base: which accounts, which motions, which segments actually pay back the effort.

  • Answer the questions that decide where the next euro of GTM spend goes.

Build foundations people trust

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on Salesforce and product data models in dbt/BigQuery.

  • Standardise metric definitions so "win rate" means one thing across sales, marketing and finance.

  • Ship dashboards GTM managers genuinely run their week on - not decks that get opened once.

Bring a point of view

  • Sit in pipeline reviews and planning as a peer, not a reporting function.

  • Push back constructively, including on the numbers people are attached to.

  • Turn analysis into crisp, written recommendations that move decisions.

Must-haves

  • Senior GTM analytics chops: 5+ years in sales, revenue or GTM analytics at B2B SaaS, with real ownership of the sales funnel.

  • Sales metrics fluency: pipeline coverage, stage conversion, velocity, win rate, ACV, quota attainment, ramp, ARR/NRR - you think in these natively.

  • CRM depth: experience with Salesforce (or equivalent) - its structure, its quirks, and the hygiene problems that quietly ruin analyses.

  • Forecasting experience: you've built or contributed to forecast models and know what makes them defensible - here you'll support RevOps on the build.

  • Technical toolkit: expert SQL; comfortable in a modern warehouse stack (BigQuery, dbt, Metabase/Hex or equivalent).

  • Planning experience: territory, quota or capacity modelling for a real sales org.

  • Business partner mindset: credible with sales leaders and reps, and able to tell a VP they're reading the data wrong.

  • Opinionated and high-agency: you spot what's worth analysing, you do it, and you arrive with a recommendation.

  • Communication that lands: memos and readouts that change what people do next.

Nice-to-haves

  • PLG experience, especially the self-serve to sales-assisted handoff.

  • Usage-based or credit-based pricing: you've analysed consumption revenue before.

  • Scoring and propensity models: lead or account scoring, statistical or ML-based.

  • Python for analysis: pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn when SQL isn't enough.

  • Devtool, open-source or technical product experience.

  • Wider GTM stack: Gong, Clay, enrichment and intent data, marketing attribution.

  • dbt modelling: you can ship your own models rather than only file requests.

You'd be the first person here whose whole job is the sales data - which means you get to define the function rather than inherit someone else's version of it. The commercial problem is interesting: a product-led motion and an enterprise motion feeding each other, on usage-based pricing, in a category that's moving very fast.

The foundations are already there. A real data team maintains the stack (BigQuery, dbt, Dagster, Metabase, Salesforce), so you spend your time on analysis rather than firefighting pipelines. And you'll work directly with GTM leadership in a company that values autonomy, directness and impact over process.

Sound like a challenge you're ready to take on? Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s most strategic enterprise deployments into production-ready success stories by embedding on-site, solving real customer problems, and building reusable automation patterns that shape our product.

To do so, you’ll work directly with customers, Deployment Strategists, and Product to make every engagement high-impact, scalable, and repeatable:

Drive high-impact enterprise deployments

Embed on-site with enterprise customers for focused 5-day deployment engagements, arriving with a hypothesis and leaving with production workflows in place.

Partner closely with Deployment Strategists to align technical execution with customer priorities, stakeholder needs, and adoption goals.

Build trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders by turning complex customer environments into clear, actionable solutions.

Build production-grade automation solutions

Design and build workflows, integrations, and custom nodes tailored to each customer’s environment and scalable beyond the initial use case.

Extend existing n8n nodes or add missing functionality where needed to unlock high-value enterprise use cases.

Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete automation designs that prioritize real customer value over technical complexity.

Work across industries and tech stacks, getting productive quickly in new environments.

Bridge customer needs with Product and Engineering

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a reusable node improvement, product feature, or platform capability.

Create a clear feedback loop with Product and Engineering by documenting technical gaps, customer context, implementation learnings, and prioritization signals.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, custom nodes, and integration patterns to an internal playbook library.

Turn customer learnings into product and playbooks

Identify when a bespoke customer requirement should become a core product feature and document it clearly for Product.

Contribute reusable learnings, workflows, and patterns to an internal playbook library.

Help ensure every engagement makes the next one faster, stronger, and more productized.

Keep engagements focused and scalable

Deliver time-boxed customer engagements with clear outcomes, rather than open-ended professional services work.

Build solutions that customers can own and operate themselves.

Know when to build, when to simplify, and when to push back to avoid unnecessary complexity.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

🧑‍💻 Strong engineering background: You have solid full-stack or backend engineering experience and have built integrations, APIs, or automation pipelines in production environments.

🧩 Integration-building expertise: You can create custom nodes, extend existing integrations, and work confidently with APIs, authentication patterns, data models, and event-driven systems.

🔧 Product-minded technical execution: You can distinguish between a one-off customer workaround, a reusable node improvement, and a product feature worth escalating.

🤝 Customer-facing confidence: You’re comfortable working directly in customer environments and can build trust with engineers, operators, and non-technical stakeholders.

🗺️ Solution design skills: You can take a messy operational problem and turn it into a clean, practical technical design.

⚖️ Strong technical judgment: You know when to build, when to push back, and how to avoid gold-plating solutions that should stay simple.

✈️ Willingness to travel: You’re open to travelling roughly 30-50% of the time for on-site engagements, primarily across Europe.

⚡ Speed to productive: You can quickly understand new industries, tech stacks, and customer environments without needing everything to be neatly defined.

Nice-to-haves

🔁 Workflow automation experience: You have familiarity with n8n or similar workflow automation tools.

🏢 Enterprise deployment experience: You’ve worked with strategic enterprise accounts in complex technical environments.

🧱 Node or connector development: You’ve built custom nodes, connectors, plugins, SDKs, or reusable integration frameworks.

🚀 Forward deployed experience: You’ve worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, or similar role at a product-led technical organization.

📣 Product feedback experience: You’ve helped turn customer learnings into clear product feedback, roadmap input, or engineering specifications.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll be the founding Forward Deployed Engineer, helping define how we turn our largest enterprise deployments into long-term, referenceable success stories. Your work won’t sit in a demo environment — you’ll build production workflows with real users, influence our product roadmap, and create the playbooks that shape how this function scales.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at a moment of huge momentum, working with a remote-first team that values autonomy, speed, experimentation, and direct customer impact.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organizations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

As we grow our US business, we’re building our SDR team in Boston and looking for an Enterprise Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organizations in the US. This isn’t about maximizing email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why n8n?

🚀 Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

📈 Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

✏️ Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

🤖 Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

⚡Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalize outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer- but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic US accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalized messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting into mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • Strong sales track record against your targets

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalization and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our Boston office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales- giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s US enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Continuously refine your outbound approach based on conversion data (connect rates, meeting-to-opportunity rates) to improve territory performance.

  • 🧪 Complex evaluations: You have experience navigating proof-of-concept and technical evaluation processes from initial interest through to close.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership, building from a blank page, and finding creative ways to unlock opportunities.

  • ⚡ Startup adaptability: You thrive in a fast-moving, hybrid startup environment where priorities evolve and autonomy is expected.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Developer ecosystem experience: You have experience selling open-source products, developer tools, or within a product-led growth company.

  • 🌱 Scale-up experience: You’ve worked in a Series A–C startup and understand what it takes to build repeatable processes while moving quickly.

  • 🌎 LATAM experience: You’re fluent in Spanish and/or have experience selling into or working with the LATAM market.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Agentic Engineering Platform Engineer

 

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

 

🎯 Your main goal will be to keep n8n operating as an AI-native engineering organization where agents are embedded across the development cycle; helping teams plan, build, test, review, learn, and improve.

You’ll do this by maintaining and evolving the platform foundations, tools, guardrails, and team processes that make agentic development safe, measurable, and sustainable. Working with Developer Platform, Security, AI/Agents, Architecture, and product engineering teams, you’ll help teams continuously adopt what works from frontier AI and make success visible through faster feedback loops, better quality, stronger resilience, and more learning from what we ship:

BUILD THE PAVED ROAD FOR AGENTIC DEVELOPMENT

  • Define safe task categories for autonomous agents, including what they can attempt, what they should never touch, and where additional review is required.

  • Design and implement isolated execution environments where agents can work without exposing secrets or accessing sensitive systems unnecessarily.

  • Build pilot workflows that allow selected Linear issues to be picked up by agents, tested, and converted into useful draft PRs.

MAKE n8n's MONOREPO AGENT-READY

  • Create and maintain repo instructions, agent playbooks, ownership metadata, coding guidelines, and documentation that improve agent performance.

  • Continuously improve developer workflows, repo structure, testability, and documentation based on where agents succeed, fail, or create reviewer friction.

  • Partner with Architecture and senior engineers to define boundaries, dependencies, and areas where agents need more context or tighter constraints.

INTEGRATE AGENTS INTO ENGINEERING WORKFLOWS

  • Integrate agentic workflows with Linear, GitHub, CI, test infrastructure, and developer review processes.

  • Design PR evidence templates that help reviewers understand what changed, why, what tests ran, what risks remain, and where human judgment is needed.

  • Partner with Security, AI/Agents, Developer Platform, and product engineering teams to define guardrails for sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions, and data handling.

MEASURE QUALITY, SAFETY, AND ADOPTION

  • Create benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate agent output quality, failure modes, test pass rates, review burden, and production risk.

  • Define quality signals and adoption metrics such as draft PR usefulness rate, reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate, and developer satisfaction.

  • Use data and feedback from pilot teams to improve agent workflows, reduce unsafe attempts, and build trust across engineering.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧠 Autonomous coding agents: You have experience with autonomous coding agents, AI coding platforms, agent orchestration systems, or internal AI developer tooling.

  • 🤖 Agentic development experience: You have practical experience building, deploying, or operating AI-assisted or agentic software development workflows that work with developers not besides them.

  • 🛠️ Strong engineering foundations: You have a strong software engineering background, ideally in platform engineering, developer experience, infrastructure, tooling, CI/CD, or engineering productivity.

  • 🧭 Ambiguity leadership: You’re comfortable leading a first-of-a-kind technical initiative from problem definition through pilot, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

  • 🔁 Modern engineering workflows: You deeply understand GitHub, CI, testing strategies, code review, monorepos, issue tracking, developer environments, and release risk.

  • 🔐 Safety-first judgment: You have strong judgment around permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • 📊 Measurable systems thinking: You know how to design benchmarks, quality signals, failure-mode tracking, and adoption metrics.

  • ✍️ Clear written communication: You’re strong at writing repo instructions, playbooks, PR evidence templates, technical proposals, and alignment documents.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You have credibility with senior engineers and can influence across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security, and Architecture without formal authority.

Nice-to-haves

  • 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js, or JavaScript monorepo.

  • ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, automated testing infrastructure, preview environments, or internal developer platforms.

  • 🛡️ Security-aware platform engineering: You have worked on sandboxing, secrets management, least-privilege access, or sensitive code ownership.

  • 📏 AI evaluation: You have created evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or quality metrics for AI-generated code or automation systems.

  • 🌍 Open-source communities: You have experience contributing to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.

  • 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling, and customer trust are central.

  • 🔗 Workflow automation: You’re familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration, or developer-facing products.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll help define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework, and developer workflows that determine whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You’ll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility, and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-a-kind role, you’ll have the opportunity to set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both internal engineering productivity and n8n’s external product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

We’re now looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to make sure our GTM team scales just as fast - and just as effectively.

🎯 Your main goal will be to enable GTM teams to close more deals faster by providing the knowledge, resources, and training they need to succeed at every stage of the buyer journey.

You’ll be helping us build on early-stage existing foundations (onboarding, certifications, tooling) and take it to the next level as we scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a direct line to revenue outcomes.

 

🚀 Build onboarding that shortens ramp time and boosts impact

  • Design and deliver world-class onboarding for new GTM team members across Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Track and continuously improve ramp time through tailored strategies and performance feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with leadership to define what “great” looks like across roles and build onboarding paths accordingly.

📚 Create scalable enablement programs that drive revenue

  • Translate product updates, GTM strategies, and technical concepts into clear, actionable content.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and build role-specific enablement initiatives to address them.

  • Design certifications and training frameworks (e.g. demo, discovery, technical proficiency) to ensure consistency and quality across the field.

🎤 Run high-impact enablement events and internal comms

  • Support the planning and execution of team-wide enablement moments like SKOs, regional kickoffs, and quarterly readiness sessions, partnering closely with sales and revenue leadership on strategy and messaging.

  • Act as the voice of enablement for GTM teams, making sure they have the right information at the right time, through the right channels.

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and RevOps to sync launches, messaging, and process changes.

📊 Measure what matters and make enablement a growth driver

  • Define and track KPIs to demonstrate enablement’s impact on sales productivity, pipeline velocity, and deal size.

  • Build a competency scorecard with GTM managers to support coaching and performance management.

  • Use insights from sales calls, Gong data, and product usage to continuously refine your programs.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📍 Based in the states where we can currently hire: you are currently located on the East Coast in one of the states where we can hire (Massachusetts, Virginia, New York, New Jersey or Florida).

  • 🧠 Sales enablement experience in PLG SaaS: You have 4+ years of enablement experience at fast-growing SaaS companies, ideally building enablement from scratch in a PLG environment.

  • 💼 Deal complexity experience: You've enabled teams selling mid-market to enterprise deals (6 to low-7 figures).

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyer fluency: You understand how to sell to technical personas (CTOs, engineering managers) and can translate that into training that resonates with a technical AE audience.

  • 📚 Learning program design: You’ve built high-quality, scalable training programs tailored to different GTM roles and seniority levels.

  • 🗣️ Strong communicator: You excel at turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and actionable content for sales teams.

  • 🧘 Organized and proactive: You’re structured, self-directed, and take ownership without needing hand-holding.

  • 🤝 Customer-first mindset: You focus on enabling the team to better articulate our value and deliver better buyer experiences.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🤖 Passion for automation and AI: You’re excited by the space we’re building in — and it shows.

  • 🔧 Familiarity with n8n: You’ve used the product (or are eager to start).

Why join us?

This is your chance to build something from the ground up: a high-leverage enablement function in a high-growth company, with a direct line to revenue impact. You'll be joining a supportive, fast-moving, and collaborative team where enablement is viewed as a strategic lever, not a support function. Help us scale our product, our message, and our people.

Apply now and help us turn our GTM teams into a world-class sales engine.

As a Customer Success Manager for our Guided segment, you will serve as the primary post-sales partner for a portfolio of approximately 30 enterprise accounts across the US West Coast region, guiding customers from onboarding through scaled adoption and long-term expansion.

You’ll run a strong operating cadence across customer engagements — including kickoffs, success planning, executive business reviews, adoption reviews, and renewals — helping customers translate product usage into measurable business outcomes and clear ROI.

You will proactively manage customer health, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive resolution across technical and business stakeholders. In addition, you’ll help design scalable playbooks and programs that improve customer outcomes across the broader customer base.

Working closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Sales, you’ll turn technical success into durable revenue growth by driving adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities that contribute to strong enterprise net revenue retention.

 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of n8n enterprise customers, acting as the primary post-sales partner across onboarding, adoption, and renewal

  • Lead customer kickoffs and success planning, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, responsibilities, and measurable outcomes

  • Drive onboarding and enablement across technical and business audiences, accelerating time-to-value and unblocking implementation challenges

  • Establish a strong operating cadence (health checks, executive syncs, QBRs), using customer data and adoption insights to guide priorities and decisions

  • Monitor customer health and product usage signals to proactively identify risks, manage escalations, and maintain stakeholder alignment

  • Quantify and communicate business value throughout the customer lifecycle, building ROI narratives tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact

  • Identify and progress expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), partnering with Account Executives on account strategies that drive customer growth

  • Partner closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to resolve blockers quickly and deliver a seamless customer experience

  • Provide structured, actionable feedback to Product and Engineering, representing customer needs and helping shape roadmap priorities

 
 

Requirements

🤝 Enterprise Customer Success experience

You’ve managed a portfolio of enterprise SaaS customers and can confidently run kickoffs, onboardings, stakeholder alignment, and QBRs end-to-end.

💻 Technical fluency

You can engage credibly with IT and engineering stakeholders across topics like APIs, integrations, authentication, environments, and automation architecture — and know when to escalate.

💼 Commercial acumen

You’ve supported renewals and expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), with a track record of driving retention and growth outcomes.

📊 Value & outcomes mindset

You’re comfortable translating product usage into measurable business outcomes, ROI, and executive-ready narratives.

🧭 Operational rigor

You run a structured operating cadence, manage competing priorities effectively, and keep stakeholders aligned with strong follow-through.

🗣 Clear, high-trust communication

You communicate clearly with both technical builders and executive stakeholders, and you’re known for building durable customer relationships.

🤝 Cross-functional leadership

You partner effectively with Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product to unblock customers and improve the customer journey.

🌱 Builder mindset in ambiguity

You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership, and enjoy building processes as the company scales.

 
 

Nice-to-haves

🤖 Automation + AI curiosity

You’ve used automation, AI tools, or workflow platforms before and can bring ideas that improve customer value realization.

🚀 Startup/scale-up experience

You’ve operated in high-growth environments and enjoy “building the plane while flying it.”

🌎 Multi-region collaboration experience

You’ve worked with distributed teams and enterprise stakeholders across multiple US time zones or globally.

🎓 Technical or STEM education

Degree or equivalent experience in a technical field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or similar.

🧩 Familiarity with n8n or similar platforms

Experience with workflow automation, integration, or iPaaS platforms will help you ramp quickly.

To make that happen, you’ll combine hands-on customer leadership, deliberate people development, and strong operational execution:

LEAD OUR MOST STRATEGIC ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS

  • Partner with CSMs to navigate complex customer challenges and develop strategies for our largest and highest-risk enterprise accounts.

  • Build trusted executive relationships with key customers and step directly into customer conversations when additional leadership is needed.

  • Stay hands-on with strategic accounts while the West team scales, including personally owning customer relationships where needed.

BUILD AND DEVELOP A HIGH-PERFORMING WEST COAST TEAM

  • Hire and onboard the remaining CSMs needed to build out the West Coast Customer Success team.

  • Coach and develop your team through structured 1:1s, clear development plans, and deliberate skill-building.

  • Create a high-accountability, supportive environment where people receive clear feedback and can continuously raise the bar.

DRIVE OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

  • Establish and run a consistent operating cadence across forecasting, account health, and structured risk reviews.

  • Build repeatable Customer Success motions across onboarding, QBRs, adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Use customer and team insights to identify risks early, raise issues proactively, and continuously improve how the team operates.

SHAPE THE CUSTOMER JOURNEY WITH CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERS

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Support, TAMs, Renewals, and GTM leaders to deliver a strong end-to-end customer experience.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success leaders across US East, EMEA, and Scaled CS to evolve shared playbooks and ways of working.

  • Contribute to global CS initiatives and help build scalable methodologies as n8n’s Customer Success organization continues to grow.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 👥 People leadership: You have 2–3+ years of people management experience, with a strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining Customer Success talent.

  • 💼 7-10 years of experience in Customer Success, Professional Services, Account Management, or other customer-facing roles, including supporting large, complex, high-risk enterprise customers.

  • 💻 Tech industry experience and relevant Enterprise subject-matter expertise: You’ve worked in an enterprise IT or technology environment and understand the needs and expectations of technical buyers and customers.

  • 📊 Operational discipline: You’re comfortable running forecasts, account-health cadences, and structured risk reviews to keep a complex book of business on track.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You thrive in environments where not everything is already defined and are willing to roll up your sleeves to solve problems directly.

  • 🤝 Low-ego collaboration: You enjoy working within a shared direction, partnering closely with peers, and improving existing processes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🚀 High-growth leadership trajectory: You’ve progressed from a senior CSM role into first-line leadership and have demonstrated strong potential to take on increasing scope.

  • 🤖 Automation and AI familiarity: You’re familiar with n8n or the broader automation and AI tooling ecosystem.

  • 🏗️ Leadership across environments: You’ve held Customer Success leadership responsibilities across more than one company and have seen different approaches to scaling teams.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll have the opportunity to shape an important new leadership layer in our US Customer Success organization and build the West Coast team around some of our largest and most technically sophisticated enterprise customers. You’ll have real influence over how we evolve our customer journey, operating model, and CS playbooks as the company scales rapidly, without having to start from zero.

You’ll join a collaborative, remote-first environment where leaders are expected to stay close to customers, develop great people, experiment, and turn what works into scalable systems. As n8n continues to grow globally and build its position in AI-powered automation, you’ll help define what world-class enterprise Customer Success looks like here.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

As our first dedicated Renewals Specialist, you’ll manage the end-to-end commercial renewal process for a high-volume portfolio of Enterprise customers, typically €20k–50k ARR, with around 60 renewals per quarter. You’ll work closely with our Scaled CSMs while helping us build the processes, operating rhythms, and automation that will allow renewals to scale as n8n grows. You'll usually work with billing/procurement contacts and the n8n champion on the account (often a technical user or engineer).

  • Partner with CSMs on renewal risk. Work closely with Scaled CSMs to understand customer health, identify potential churn or commercial risk early, and determine the right path to renewal.

  • Keep the forecast accurate. Maintain reliable renewal forecasts, close-plan notes, and CRM hygiene so we have a clear view of upcoming renewals and revenue retention.

  • Build a more scalable renewal motion. Identify where processes break down or create unnecessary manual work, and improve the workflows, templates, operating rhythms, and automation behind them.

  • Navigate the business independently. Partner with Finance, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve commercial or contractual blockers and keep renewals moving.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🔄 B2B SaaS renewals experience: You’ve owned commercial renewals, account management, or a commercially focused Customer Success portfolio in B2B SaaS, including negotiating contracts and renewals with business customers.

  • 📚 High-volume portfolio management: You’ve managed a sizeable book of customers and are comfortable keeping dozens of commercial conversations moving simultaneously. Experience with smaller Enterprise accounts and roughly €20k–50k ARR contracts is particularly relevant.

  • 🤝 Commercial & contractual confidence: You’re comfortable negotiating pricing and terms and navigating the practical mechanics of SaaS renewals — quotes, order forms, procurement, legal review, approvals, and signatures.

  • 📈 Operational rigor: You manage your renewal pipeline with discipline. Forecasts, dates, next steps, and CRM data stay accurate, and you take ownership of getting contracts closed on time.

  • 🚀 High-growth startup experience: You’ve worked in a fast-growing environment where processes change quickly, ownership is high, and the answer isn't always already documented.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You don't just execute a process — you notice where it isn't working and help improve it. You’re comfortable creating structure while doing the work at the same time.

  • 🤖 Automation mindset: You’re interested in using automation and AI to eliminate repetitive work and make high-volume processes more scalable.

Nice-to-haves

  • ⚡ Scaled Customer Success experience: You’ve worked in a high-volume or scaled CS/renewals model before.

  • 🏢 Exposure to a mature renewals function: You’ve seen what strong renewal processes look like at a larger SaaS company and can bring some of those learnings into an earlier-stage environment.

  • 🛠️ Relevant tooling: Experience with CRM, CS, or renewals tooling such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar.

  • 🤖 n8n experience: You’ve used n8n or another workflow automation platform and are excited about what automation can do.

At n8n, you won’t be stepping into a fully established renewal function - you’ll help create it.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on commercial ownership with building something from the ground up. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal, and you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work on our customers and revenue.

We’re particularly interested in using AI and automation to scale the function without simply adding more headcount, so if you enjoy finding smarter ways to eliminate repetitive work and improve processes, you’ll have plenty of room to experiment.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now and help us build the renewal motion that will support n8n’s next stage of growth.
